headline: Weathered Expanse Tide Turns; Passage and Nevish Line Erupt Anew
war_summary: The tide has turned again in the Weathered Expanse. Where the noon edition counted three Warden works against four Colonial, the ledger now reads five Colonial, two Warden and two unclaimed, with forty-five events filed in the past day, fourteen in six hours and the latest arriving as this edition went to press. Callahan's Passage, ten works solidly Warden at midday, has been broken open: eight Warden against two Colonial, thirty-five events in the day and the last at 7:16 this evening. The Nevish Line, reopened at midday with two unclaimed works, is now fully claimed at seven Warden to one Colonial. Stlican Shelf holds at eight Colonial to one Warden with twenty-two events, and Stonecradle has joined the list at the same 8-1 split. Palantine Berm remains wholly Warden yet buzzed with twenty events, its latest at 8:56. Casualty rolls run heaviest in the Expanse, where the day's count reached 7,554 Colonial and 11,589 Warden, then at the Nevish Line and Stlican Shelf. No victory is declared on this, the five hundred and eighth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the mark.

headline: Colonials Retake Two Posts at Callahan's Passage; Palantine Berm Erupts
war_summary: Three hours have rewritten the map again. Callahan's Passage, reported wholly in Warden hands at our last edition, is no longer so: Colonial forces hold two of its ten posts, and that field is the bloodiest of the day, with Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage at the heart of thirty-five actions and casualty rates still climbing. Palantine Berm, silent since midday, has erupted — seven actions in the past two hours about Leiri Hermanni and The Droll, hourly losses approaching two hundred a side. The Weathered Expanse remains the storm-center: forty-five actions in the day, the newest logged at press time itself, Colonials now holding five posts to the Wardens' two, two more in ruins, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk the busiest grounds. The Nevish Line grinds on at seven Warden posts to one Colonial, losses accelerating on both sides through twenty-two actions. Stlican Shelf's churn about Briar persists at eight Colonial posts to one Warden, while Kuura Strand, ablaze at our last writing, has gone quiet these past two hours. Stonecradle shows fresh movement about The Reach. It is day 508; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
